typography.instructions: Import 'Playfair Display' and 'Oswald' from Google Fonts in index.css. Use these strictly to create the premium casino storytelling feel.

layouts.main_container: 100vh, w-full, hidden overflow, flex flex-col items-center justify-center relative. Background must be very dark almost black with a subtle, very large radial-gradient in the center for the ambient blue lighting.
layouts.header: Absolute top-0 left-0 w-full text-center pt-8. The title 'All in: the Story of Rajsekhar' must be large, elegant (Playfair Display), and gold.
layouts.poker_table: Absolute center of the screen. Shape: an ellipse (w-[90vw] md:w-[70vw] lg:w-[60vw] h-[55vh] md:h-[65vh] rounded-[50%]). Thick dark wood border (border-[12px] md:border-[20px] border-[#2A1810]) for the rail, with inner shadow for depth. Background uses the felt image layered with a dark green tint.
layouts.seats: Positioned absolutely along the edge of the table using percentages (e.g., top-left, top-right, middle-left, middle-right, bottom-left, bottom-right). Transform: translate(-50%, -50%) for perfect centering on the edge.
layouts.controls: Absolute bottom-10 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-40. Flex row, gap-6. Rendered only when a seat is selected.
layouts.overlay: Fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/95 backdrop-blur-xl flex flex-col p-8 lg:p-24.

components.TableCenter: Positioned in the absolute center of the table. Contains the decorative chip stack image and the tagline 'Every Chapter Was a Bet.' in the gold Playfair Display font.
components.Seat: A flex column container. Top: Circular avatar (w-14 h-14 md:w-20 md:h-20) with a dark background, gold border, and gold initials. When active, it gets a massive golden box-shadow glow (shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(255,215,0,0.7)]). Middle: Player name in Oswald font, uppercase. Bottom: A small lucide-react chip icon or coin icon.
components.ActionButtons: Buttons styled like casino chips. Rounded-full, border-2 border-dashed inside, bold uppercase text. Bet button: green background, white text, includes a playing card icon. Fold button: red background, white text.
components.StoryOverlay: Top area contains a subtle 'Back to Table' button. Below, a massive chapter title (gold). Below that, a max-w-3xl container for the story text which reveals via a typewriter effect.
components.FoldToast: A custom red toast notification (bg-red-900 border border-red-500 text-white px-6 py-3 rounded-md shadow-2xl). Stays for exactly 3 seconds. It displays a funny message unique to the player folded against.

motion.seat_selection: transition-all duration-300 ease-out. Scale up slightly (scale-110) and add the golden glow when active.
motion.controls_entrance: Framer motion or CSS animation: slide up from 20px below and fade in.
motion.overlay_slide: Framer motion: initial={y: '100%'} animate={y: 0} transition={{ duration: 0.6, ease: [0.22, 1, 0.36, 1] }}.
motion.typewriter_text: Framer motion staggerChildren on characters, or a simple useEffect that reveals a substring character by character over time.
motion.card_deal_animation: Absolute positioned card images in the background of the overlay that animate in (rotate and translate) as the overlay opens, simulating cards being dealt on the table.
motion.toast: Slide down from -100% to 0, hold for 3s, then slide back up.

table_felt.description: Solid green textured background for the poker table felt

chip_stack.description: Scattered casino chips for the center of the table

cards.description: Playing cards for subtle background animation in the overlay

instructions_to_main_agent: Build this as a single-page interactive experience in App.js.
Use standard Tailwind CSS classes. Use the image URLs provided for the table texture and central chip stack.
Create a 'players' array containing the 6 players and their unique fold messages. Maintain an 'activePlayer' state.
Clicking a player sets 'activePlayer'. This triggers the golden glow via conditional classes and reveals the Bet/Fold buttons.
Clicking 'Bet' toggles an 'overlayOpen' state. Use Framer Motion (or standard CSS transitions if you prefer) to slide in the full-screen overlay from the bottom.
Implement the typewriter effect for the story text in the overlay. Make sure it resets when opening a new chapter.
Implement the subtle card-dealing animation in the overlay background using Framer Motion.
Clicking 'Fold' should trigger a custom toast (or use the 'sonner' library if preferred) positioned at the top center. Show the player's unique fold message for exactly 3 seconds.
Ensure the layout is highly responsive. The elliptical table should adjust width and height to fit mobile viewports while maintaining the overhead view illusion.
Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements, e.g., 'data-testid="seat-1"', 'data-testid="bet-button"', 'data-testid="fold-button"', 'data-testid="back-to-table"'.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. This results in breaking transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed.
